manifest.title_en: The legal basis of the role
objectives_fil: Maipaliwanag at mailapat sa isang sitwasyon: legal na batayan ng tungkulin.
objectives_en: Explain and apply in a situation: the legal basis of the role.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang pagtatanong tungkol sa nararapat matanggap ay hindi kasakiman — ito ay bahagi ng pagiging responsableng BHW.
sections.takeaway_en: Asking about your benefits isn't greed — it's part of being a responsible BHW.

sections.takeaway_fil: May legal na batayan ang tungkulin ng BHW — hindi lang ito kagustuhan, kundi bahagi ng RA 7883.
sections.takeaway_en: The BHW's duty has a legal basis — it is not just goodwill, it is part of RA 7883.
